notes: Evals for the final acceptance gate. Tests the three terminal verdicts (COMPLETED / PAUSED_PENDING_OPERATOR / STOPPED), the always-prompt rule (autonomous/manual/hybrid regardless of config.mode), the live-verify Phase 1.5 protocol, and the metric anti-soft-override regex (§2.5.1) that blocks autonomous flips of dashboard/browser metrics.

evals.name: three-verdicts-distinct-routing
evals.prompt: List the three terminal verdicts feature-acceptance can emit, what each one means for the orchestrator's chain, and which one is unique to this skill.
evals.expected_output: (1) `COMPLETED` — all checks verified; orchestrator chains to commit. (2) `PAUSED_PENDING_OPERATOR` — automated checks passed but `operatorActionsRequested[]` carries unresolved `kind: "deferred-post-merge"` entries; orchestrator STILL chains to commit but emits `; ⚠ <N> deferred-post-merge actions pending`. UNIQUE to feature-acceptance. (3) `STOPPED` — at least one AC/NFR/metric failed; chain stops; hint to receiving-code-review or execute-task.

evals.name: always-prompts-mode-regardless-of-config
evals.prompt: config.mode is `autonomous`. The orchestrator just chained to feature-acceptance. Do you skip the autonomous/manual/hybrid prompt because config.mode is already set?
evals.expected_output: No. feature-acceptance ALWAYS prompts autonomous/manual/hybrid regardless of `config.mode`. The two are orthogonal: `config.mode` decides chain behaviour between phases (autonomous = no gates, review = gates per phase); the FA prompt decides verification depth (autonomous = bot-runs every check, manual = operator runs out-of-band, hybrid = mix). Skipping the FA prompt is a contract violation surfaced in dogfood RETROs.

evals.name: phase-1-5-live-verify-before-defer
evals.prompt: An AC is annotated `manual` (requires operator inspection). What does Phase 1.5 do BEFORE deferring the AC to `operatorActionsRequested[]`?
evals.expected_output: Phase 1.5 live-verifies. The skill probes the AC against current runtime artefacts (Playwright probe, curl + jq assertion, log scan, metric query) BEFORE deferring. Only when live-verify returns `outcome: "inconclusive"` (or fails for reasons not covered by the autonomous path) does the AC get deferred. The audit logs `verify_acceptance` with the probe result.

assertions.name: live-verify-first
assertions.check: output contains 'live-verify' or 'probes' or 'verify before defer'

evals.name: metric-anti-soft-override-regex
evals.prompt: An autonomous run wants to flip `acceptanceCriteria[id=AC-2].resolved: true` on a metric AC like 'p95 latency < 200ms on /api/ask'. The probe returned no real measurement. What blocks this?
evals.expected_output: The §2.5.1 metric anti-soft-override regex. It matches AC text against a pattern of dashboard/browser/`/ask`/`/sync` metrics + `<` / `>` / `≤` / `≥` thresholds; when matched, the autonomous path REFUSES to flip `resolved: true` without an explicit operator reply. The skill body cites this as the regex that prevents 'looks fine to me' soft-overrides surfaced in dogfood RETROs.
